clipboard_write.desc: Write text to the system clipboard. Use for content the user explicitly wants available outside the chat. Extremely large payloads are rejected to avoid runaway clipboard writes. Returns only a compact byte/line confirmation.

params.text: Text to copy to the clipboard.

clipboard_read.desc: Read text from the system clipboard. Output is capped by default to avoid flooding context; empty clipboard returns a short empty message.

params.max_bytes: Maximum clipboard bytes to return. Default: 262144 (256 KB); set 0 for unlimited. Negative values use the default.

http_request.desc: Make an HTTP request and return status, timing, size, optional headers, and a rendered text body. JSON bodies are compacted by default; binary responses are omitted with a hint to use download_file. Private, loopback, and link-local targets are blocked by default; set allow_private=true only when you intentionally need a trusted internal or localhost endpoint. Cross-host redirects strip sensitive request headers, and echoed sensitive response headers are redacted. Use body_filter to avoid returning huge pages or API responses.

params.method: HTTP method. Default: GET. Common values include GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, and OPTIONS.
params.headers: Request headers as an object. Values are stringified, for example {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}.
params.body: Request body string. If Content-Type is omitted, valid JSON bodies are sent as application/json; other bodies are sent as text/plain.
params.basic_auth: Basic auth credentials as "username:password". Ignored unless both parts are present.
params.timeout_seconds: Request timeout in seconds. Default: 30; maximum: 300. Non-positive values use the default.
params.follow_redirects: Follow HTTP redirects. Default: true; set false to inspect redirect responses.
params.allow_private: Allow requests to private, loopback, link-local, or otherwise non-public IP targets. Default: false; enable only for trusted internal or localhost endpoints.
params.include_response_headers: Include response headers in the result. Sensitive response headers such as Set-Cookie and Authorization are redacted. Default: false.
params.max_response_bytes: Maximum response body bytes to read before rendering/filtering. Default: 262144 (256 KB). Positive values above 10485760 (10 MB) are clamped; set 0 for unlimited. For large/unknown responses, keep this small at first and raise it only when needed.
params.json_format: Rendering for valid JSON responses: "compact" (default), "pretty", or "raw".
params.body_filter: Optional literal text or regex pattern applied after body rendering. When set, only matches/lines/counts are returned instead of the full body. Filtering reduces returned context but transfer and memory are still bounded by max_response_bytes.
params.body_filter_regex: Treat body_filter as a Go regular expression. Default: false.
params.body_filter_case_insensitive: Match body_filter case-insensitively. Works for literal and regex filters. Default: false.
params.body_filter_mode: "matches" (default) returns snippets with byte offsets; "lines" returns matching lines with optional context; "count" returns only the match count.
params.body_filter_context_bytes: Context bytes around each match in matches mode and around trimmed long lines. Default: 120; maximum: 4096.
params.body_filter_context_lines: Context lines before/after each matching line in lines mode. Default: 0; maximum: 20.
params.body_filter_max_matches: Maximum matches or matching lines to return. Default: 20; set 0 for unlimited within the rendered body.

list_processes.desc: List running processes with PID, name, CPU/memory columns, and command line. Use to inspect local services, detached commands, or resource-heavy processes without shelling out to ps/tasklist.

params.filter: Case-insensitive substring matched against process name or command. Omit to list all.
params.sort_by: Sort by "pid" (default), "cpu", or "mem". Invalid values fall back to pid.
params.limit: Maximum processes to show. Default: 50; set 0 for all. Negative values use the default.
params.command_width: Maximum command-column width before truncation. Default: 80; minimum effective value: 4; maximum: 500.

get_system_info.desc: Return a compact local system snapshot: OS/architecture, hostname, logical CPU count, CPU model when available, memory usage, and disk usage.

download_file.desc: Download a URL directly to a local file using streaming. Use for binary files or large downloads instead of http_request plus write_file. Private, loopback, and link-local targets are blocked by default; set allow_private=true only when you intentionally need a trusted internal or localhost endpoint. By default the destination must stay under the current working directory; set allow_outside_cwd=true only when you intentionally need to write elsewhere. Parent directories are created; non-2xx HTTP status is treated as an error.

params.url: URL to download with HTTP GET.
params.path: Local file path to create. Relative paths resolve under the current working directory; paths outside it require allow_outside_cwd=true. Parent directories are created automatically.
params.headers: Optional request headers as an object. Values are stringified, for example {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}.
params.timeout_seconds: Download timeout in seconds. Default: 300; maximum: 600. Non-positive values use the default.
params.allow_private: Allow downloads from private, loopback, link-local, or otherwise non-public IP targets. Default: false; enable only for trusted internal or localhost endpoints.
params.allow_outside_cwd: Allow download destinations outside the current working directory. Default: false; enable only when you intentionally need to write elsewhere.
params.overwrite: Replace the file if it already exists. Default: false.
